rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n; for i from 1 through n, add i*i only when i is divisible by 14; print the total plus 12.
rows.target:

DISPLAYNL(total).

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n; add evens and subtract odds from 1 through n, then add 10.
rows.target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total = 10.
LOOP (NUMBER i = 1 TILL i <= n, i++) { IF (i % 2 == 0) { total += i. } ELSE { total -= i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

rows.prompt: Read nonnegative n; sum the cubes of odd i from 1 through n, then subtract 14.

DISPLAYNL(total-14).

rows.prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers into an array; sum squares of negative entries, then add 4.

SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).

NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
